title: 第13章 初识第14章 宇宙联合国新增公民一位
content_zh:
米莉许久没有说话，格林帝国也有开拓的异大陆，现在有两个一个是温顿泽大陆还有一个是艾玛大陆，但是跟宇宙联合国不同，格林帝国是靠战争征服对方，而宇宙联合国是靠文明文化同化对方，还有格林帝国是靠大魔法师在奥术海洋游历发现其它的“星球”
（法师在奥术海之中发现的星球都是有生命的星球，只是并不是所有的星都合适这个世界的人生活，甚至有些星球的原住民并不比这个世界的弱！
）能不能开发还是个问题，宇宙联合国称呼天启大陆这样的世界为星球，不过确实是一个球体，但是为什么人生活在上面不会掉下去了呢？
还有他们的是魔法或者说是炼金术也太强大了，所以可以制造出这么巨大的金属造物，行者号飞船竟然有一万米高！
打破了米莉的认知，还有宇宙中的星球竟然比海边的沙子还要多！
这么多世界，如果格林帝国都是靠着武力征服那格林帝国全民皆兵都没用！
米莉有太多太多的问题了！
还有宇宙联合国普通人也可以操控巨大的金属傀儡，钢铁飞船！
他们没有魔法！
米莉感觉这才是一个真实的世界（这是吉恩给她看的资料里面没有修真者要不然还不得颠覆她的三观），米莉感觉这样的世界才是一个合适人们生活的世界！
但是又怕像格林帝国这样的势力找到他们！
入侵它们，不过在看到宇宙联合国的武力才放心了（何止是放心…如果给她看的资料是真的，就现在她呆的这艘名字叫行者号的飞船，一炮下去，反正就是一种武器一炮就能毁灭掉整个天启大陆所在的世界！
包括其它的所有势力种族，精灵矮人兽人！
）当她发现这么强大的武器竟然普通人就能控制的时候不由得奇怪问道，为什么这么强大的武器给普通人使用？吉恩回答她说，因为这些武器都是这些普通人创造的啊！
不由得让米莉感觉自己所在的这个世界普通人的作用没有发挥出来，更加坚定了她心里想让普通人也能发挥自己作用的想法！
然后吉恩又告诉她这是没有办法的，因为格林帝国是魔法斗气的文明，这种个人武力至上的文明刚刚开始的时候发展非常的快，因为他们可以整合整个文明的力量加快文明进程，不过反过来说它的制约性是非常强的，因为当这个文明的统治者不想前进的时候整个文明就不会进步了，统治阶层稳的让后来的人根本无法撼动！
反过来看，没有异能或者超自然力量的文明虽然刚刚开始一直处在战争中，但是当他们发展到一定得层次后就没有战争了，只能对外扩张！
就是各种武器发展出来，你敢开战我就敢给世界打GG的阶段后，对内战争就会慢慢的变的少了，不过宇宙联合国这个文明都成立有几十万年了，所以深度来讲两个文明没有可比性，但是表层社会发展还是可以比较的。
“对了吉恩，这艘飞船上有那种一炮下去整个星球被毁灭的武器吗？”
好不容易缓过来，还没消化的米莉问吉恩道。

“有啊，不过你就别想了，我还没有成为这艘船的船长，很多功能我都无法使用。”
吉恩耸耸肩表示没法子，他在想是不是米莉受了刺激打算报复社会。
“你想什么呢！
这可是我的家园！
我怎么可能伤害她？但是我有个想法，我想要让所有的普通人都有自己的追求，而不是只能依靠神殿才有信仰，他们也能以自己而骄傲！
为这个世界做贡献，可以把跟神灵祈祷的时间花在创造上！
我要让他们知道自己也能改变世界！”
米莉激动道！
“不会吧，米莉你受刺激了吗？你这叫革命！
这会死很多人的哦，还有你这动了统治者的利益了哦，还有你怎么突然会有这个想法的？奇怪？”
吉恩不由得奇道，难不成这是突然就悟了？或者被门夹了？
“没有啊，我就是感觉现在的普通人生活太辛苦了，吉恩你在斯凯格丝海港活过着两点一线的生活，也很少与他人交流，所以你不知道斯凯格丝海港底层的普通人生活有多么不容易！
天启大陆还好点，第五大陆最乱了，我听我同学讲过，在那边就算是领主如果你自己的实力不够强大都会被领民杀死的！
因为那边也有很多第五大陆的原住民，我们格林帝国就是靠打压他们获取利益，如果我们可以让领民生活变好，有事做有追求就不会跟领主有矛盾！
我才十六岁就两阶剑士了，在等几年应该就能用三阶了，或者四阶！
我们能保护自己又可以带着领民创造他们想要的生活他们跟我们就没有矛盾了不是？”
米莉大声道。
“那我不得不给你浇盆冷水了，新大陆那边有中级战士学院吗？有高级学院吗？没有老师教你靠自己能成吗？再说了你以为三阶四阶就能够无敌了吗…”
吉恩还是感觉米莉可能是受刺激了，不过她的想法有有些单纯，我们在做很多事的时候，不是每一次都需要用拳头才能做成功的，我们还有脑子，不过这种挨打的花吉恩是不会说的。
本小章还未完，请点击下一页继续阅读后面精彩内容！

“…好吧，确实没有，不过到了第五大陆的大城市我们可以去找个教师老师！
我们要努力赚钱！”
不过马上米莉又给自己与吉恩打气道！
“呃，小七如果我想让米莉学习修真可以吗？你想好了，米莉可是我在这个世界上唯一的亲人了！
content_en:
Milly didn't speak for a long time. The Green Empire has also opened up foreign continents. There are currently two continents, one is Winton Ze continent and the other is Emma continent. But unlike the Universal United Nations, the Green Empire relies on war to conquer each other, while the Universal United Nations relies on civilization and culture to assimilate each other. The Green Empire relies on great magicians to travel in the arcane ocean to discover other "planets"
(The planets discovered by the mage in the Arcane Sea are all living planets, but not all stars are suitable for people in this world to live, and even the aborigines of some planets are no weaker than those of this world!
) is still a question whether it can be developed. The United Nations of the Universe calls a world like Apocalypse Continent a planet, but it is indeed a sphere. But why do people living on it not fall down?
Also, their magic or alchemy is too powerful, so they can create such huge metal creations. The Walker spacecraft is actually 10,000 meters high!
It broke Milly's knowledge that there are more planets in the universe than there are sands on the seashore!
There are so many worlds, if the Green Empire relies on force to conquer, then it will be useless if all the people of the Green Empire are armed!
Millie has so many questions!
There is also the Universal United Nations, where ordinary people can control huge metal puppets and steel spaceships!
They have no magic!
Milly feels that this is a real world (this is because there are no cultivators in the information Jean showed her, otherwise it would have to subvert her three views). Milly feels that this kind of world is a world suitable for people to live in!
But they are afraid that forces like the Green Empire will find them!
Invading them, but she felt relieved after seeing the force of the Universal United Nations (more than reassured... If the information shown to her is true, the spacecraft named Walker she is staying in now, with one shot, is a weapon that can destroy the entire world where Apocalypse Continent is located with one shot!
Including all other powerful races, elves, dwarves, orcs!
) When she discovered that such a powerful weapon could be controlled by ordinary people, she couldn't help but wonder, why are such powerful weapons used by ordinary people? Jean answered her, because these weapons were created by ordinary people!
Milly couldn't help but feel that the role of ordinary people in the world she lived in had not been played out, which strengthened her idea that ordinary people could also play their role!
Then Gene told her that there was no way around it, because the Green Empire was a civilization of magic and grudges. This kind of civilization where personal force was supreme developed very fast at the beginning because they could integrate the power of the entire civilization to speed up the progress of civilization. However, on the other hand, it was very restrictive, because when the ruler of this civilization did not want to move forward, the entire civilization would not progress, and the ruling class was so stable that subsequent generations could not shake it!
On the other hand, although civilizations without supernatural powers or supernatural powers have always been in war at the beginning, when they develop to a certain level, there will be no wars and they can only expand externally!
After the development of various weapons, and if you dare to start a war, I will fight against the world, civil wars will gradually become less common. However, the civilization of the United Nations has been established for hundreds of thousands of years, so in depth, the two civilizations are not comparable, but the superficial social development can still be compared.
"By the way, Jean, does this spaceship have the kind of weapon that can destroy the entire planet with one shot?"
Milly, who had finally recovered but still hadn't digested it, asked Gene.
"Yes, but don't think about it. I haven't become the captain of this ship yet, and I can't use many functions."
Gene shrugged and said there was nothing he could do. He was wondering if Millie had been stimulated and wanted to take revenge on society.
"What are you thinking!
This is my home!
How could I possibly hurt her? But I have an idea, II want all ordinary people to have their own pursuits, instead of relying on temples to have faith, and they can also be proud of themselves!
To contribute to the world, you can spend the time praying to God on creation!
I want them to know that they too can change the world! "
Milly said excitedly!
"No way, Milly, are you stimulated? You call this a revolution!
This will kill a lot of people, and you have touched the interests of the ruler. And why did you suddenly have this idea? strangeness? "
Gene couldn't help but wonder, could it be that he suddenly realized this? Or got caught in the door?
"No, I just feel that the life of ordinary people nowadays is too hard. Gene, you live a two-point and one-line life in Skeggs Harbor and rarely communicate with others, so you don't know how difficult the life of ordinary people at the bottom of Skeggs Harbor is!
Apocalypse Continent is better, but the fifth continent is the most chaotic. I heard my classmates say that even if you are a lord there, if you are not strong enough, you will be killed by the people!
Because there are also many natives of the Fifth Continent there, and our Green Empire relies on suppressing them to gain profits. If we can make the lives of the people in the territory better and have things to do and pursue, we will not have conflicts with the lords!
I am a level 2 swordsman when I am only sixteen. I should be able to use level 3 or level 4 in a few years!
If we can protect ourselves and lead the people to create the life they want, then they will have no conflict with us, right? "
Millie shouted.
"Then I have to pour cold water on you. Is there an intermediate warrior academy in the New World? Are there any senior colleges? Can you do it on your own without a teacher to teach you? Besides, do you think that level three and level four can make you invincible..."
Gene still felt that Milly might have been stimulated, but her thoughts were a bit simple. When we do many things, we don't need to use fists every time to succeed. We still have brains, but Gene will not say anything about this kind of beating.
